_comment: How research outputs are grouped and coloured in the two donut charts, on
One definition for both, so a slice is the same colour wherever it is drawn.
`types` are values of the `type` field in data/outputs.json; anything not
listed here is not counted (Press and Presentation belong to Media).
Why only five slices, when there are nine output types: a donut has to be
read by matching any slice to any legend row, so every pair of colours must
be tellable apart — including under colour-vision deficiency, in light and
dark. Four hues is the most that clears that bar; the fifth slot is the
neutral 'Other'. The legend's count table carries the detail the wedges
drop, and the sections below the chart list every output individually.
Colours are the validated categorical palette: blue / yellow / green /
magenta, each with a step for the light surface and one for the dark.
Verified all-pairs in both modes (worst normal-vision dE 19.3, worst CVD
dE 6.9 with the table view as relief). Do not substitute a colour without
re-validating the set as a whole.
